evals.name: limit-order-bot-setup
evals.prompt: I'm building a TypeScript market-maker bot that places a SUI/USDC limit buy at $2.10 with size 10 SUI on mainnet. Show me the full setup: SDK init, BalanceManager creation, depositing collateral, and the place-order call. Use the current @mysten/deepbook-v3 SDK (not the legacy clob_v2). Make sure DEEP fee handling is covered.
evals.expected_output: TS code using DeepBookClient + BalanceManagerContract + placeLimitOrder with payWithDeep, correct human-unit conventions, mentions DEEP funding.

evals.name: leveraged-long-margin
evals.prompt: Show me how to open a 3x leveraged long on SUI/USDC using DeepBook margin trading. I need TS code that creates a MarginManager, deposits USDC collateral, borrows, places the margin limit order via PoolProxy, and refreshes Pyth price feeds in the same PTB. Also explain liquidation health.
evals.expected_output: TS code using MarginManagerContract + PoolProxyContract + Pyth refresh; mentions health factor, Pyth max age, permissionless liquidation, and the `pythAccessToken` requirement (deepbook-v3 2.0).

evals.name: indexer-ohlcv-fetch
evals.prompt: I need to fetch 24h OHLCV candles for the DEEP/USDC pool from DeepBook. Should I use the SDK or the indexer? Give me the actual HTTP call.
evals.expected_output: Recommends indexer (not SDK) for historical OHLCV; provides correct base URL https://deepbook-indexer.mainnet.mystenlabs.com and the /ohlcv endpoint with pool_id + interval params.
